_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every project on the site.
Array order IS grid order — reorder entries here, re-run make_projects.mjs.
Never hand-edit project markup: the home grid (between the PROJECTS markers
in index.html), work/index.html and work/<slug>/index.html are all generated
and will be overwritten.
published:false keeps a project s data intact but excludes it from the home
teaser, from /work/, from the next-project loop, and deletes its case-study
directory so no live URL is stranded. Flip it to true to bring the project
back — point thumb/hero/gallery at real media first.
studio   — which studio made it. Drives the filter pills.
category — project TYPE, orthogonal to studio. Reserved for future filtering.
The home page shows a capped teaser (2 per studio, see layout.mjs) followed
by See all work. /work/ carries the full published set. Both are the same
asymmetric pair grid and differ only in how much of the catalogue they show.
reel/clips are Cloudflare R2 URLs, uploaded by upload_r2.mjs. The local
assets/**/*.mp4 they were derived from are gitignored and never committed;
regenerate them with make_media.mjs if you need to re-upload. reel drives
hover-to-play on every tile, the fullscreen preview behind it, and the
reel section on that project's case study.
reelAspect is the reel's own aspect ratio, as a CSS ratio. It is recorded
rather than derived because the encoder preserves each source's shape, so
the reels are NOT a common ratio — currently 1/1, 4/3 and 16/9. The case
study sizes its frame from this, which both reserves the box before the
video loads (no layout shift) and keeps a square reel from being cropped
into a widescreen slot. It cannot be probed at build time: the local mp4s
are gitignored, so a clean checkout has nothing to measure. Re-probe with
ffprobe and update this by hand if a reel is re-cut at a new shape.
lede is placeholder copy. Real project narrative goes here — not invented.
blurb is currently read by nothing. It existed for the /work lookbook, which
was replaced by the asymmetric grid; the field is kept because the copy it
asks for is worth writing, but nothing renders it today.
